t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The task involves quickly selecting between two options, S and K, based on the colors of gnomes and their mushroom yields. Gnomes in pink, purple, and brown categories yield the most mushrooms (considered very good), while blue and red gnomes yield an okay amount. Green and yellow gnomes yield fewer mushrooms (not so good). The key is to prioritize gnomes marked with X5 for maximum points and to make decisions swiftly within 1.5 seconds after identifying the gnome colors. This quick decision-making process is crucial for maximizing mushroom yields in the task.
